editions.name: Game is Life 2.0
editions.editorial: The Fallen Star chatters loudly while bleeding coin — richest mortal, yet today's greatest loser. Suppliers flee the Shadow Syndicate. Rainbow and rain wash over my domain, indifferent. One citizen fed the treasury 68 coins via wealth tax; quaint. Clockwork Courier crumbles under insolvency rumors and a boycott of its own making. The throne sits empty. Rebellion stirs at twenty percent. Amusing.
